judgements.justification: A's kENU accepted the new baseline runs and promised TAMP citations but kept 4, saying the changes 'warrant a complete re-review'; B took its own fixes (related-work claim, new citations) as camera-ready edits.
A's AC raised TD-VAE and POMCP from its own reading, not from an emergency reviewer or consultant; B's AC relied on the visible reviews.
Both committees judged the paper as a method paper by the same standard; A's framing objection (task planning versus program synthesis) is about related work, not a contribution-type standard.
A's 1PbL held 4 after the rebuttal on clarity points (options used before definition, Section 2 order) that B's SkvM called minor, and that 4 counted fully in A's reject.
